article.headline: Charleston (SC) opens its season with a 111-55 win over Southern Wesleyan
article.description: — Eli Ellis’ 16 points helped Charleston (SC) make its season debut with a 111-55 victory over Southern Wesleyan on Monday.
article.linkText: Charleston (SC) opens its season with a 111-55 win over Southern Wesleyan
article.story: CHARLESTON, S.C. -- — Eli Ellis’ 16 points helped Charleston (SC) make its season debut with a 111-55 victory over Southern Wesleyan on Monday. Ellis went 6 for 8 from the field, including 4 for 5 from 3-point range, for the Cougars. Xavier Abreu shot 7 for 11 from the field, including 0 for 3 from beyond the arc, to add 14 points. Ben Bradford had 12 points and shot 5 for 9 from the field, including 2 for 6 from beyond the arc. Isaiah Smith finished with 11 points for the Warriors. RJ Lacossade added nine points for Southern Wesleyan. Zion Dixon also had six points. Up next Charleston (SC) hosts Newberry on Friday. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
